name: Select

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component to be rendered inside the `Select` component

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Optionally provide the default value of the `<select>`

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the control is disabled

props.name: helperText
props.description: Provide text that is used alongside the control label for additional help

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether the label should be hidden, or not

props.name: inline
props.description: Specify whether you want the inline version of this control

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify if the currently value is invalid.

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Message which is displayed if the value is invalid.

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide label text to be read by screen readers when interacting with the control.

props.name: light
props.description: `true` to use the light version. For use on $ui-01 backgrounds only. Don't use this to make tile background color same as container background color. It will be moved in the next major release.

props.name: noLabel
props.description: Reserved for use with Pagination component. Will not render a label for the select since Pagination renders one for us.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the select should be read-only

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Select Input.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `Slug` component to be rendered inside the `Dropdown` component

props.name: warn
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently in warning state

props.name: warnText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon Select rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
